description: PCOS risk prediction model trained on user-answerable features only. Uses L2-regularized logistic regression with balanced class weights.

factor_descriptions.Age (yrs): Your age may be associated with changes in hormonal balance.
factor_descriptions.Weight (Kg): Body weight can influence hormonal regulation and metabolism.
factor_descriptions.Height(Cm): Height is factored into body composition assessment.
factor_descriptions.BMI: A higher BMI is commonly associated with PCOS-related risk factors.
factor_descriptions.Blood Group: Blood group is included as a demographic factor in the model.
factor_descriptions.Hip(inch): Hip measurement contributes to body composition assessment.
factor_descriptions.Waist(inch): Waist measurement can indicate central body fat distribution.
factor_descriptions.Waist:Hip Ratio: A higher waist-to-hip ratio may suggest central fat distribution, which is linked to metabolic changes.
factor_descriptions.Cycle_Irregular: Irregular menstrual cycles are one of the most common indicators associated with PCOS.
factor_descriptions.Cycle length(days): Cycle length outside the typical 21-35 day range may suggest hormonal irregularities.
factor_descriptions.Pregnant(Y/N): Pregnancy status is factored into the hormonal assessment.
factor_descriptions.No. of abortions: Reproductive history is included as a contextual factor.
factor_descriptions.Weight gain(Y/N): Unexplained weight gain can be associated with insulin resistance, a common feature of PCOS.
factor_descriptions.hair growth(Y/N): Excessive hair growth (hirsutism) may indicate elevated androgen levels.
factor_descriptions.Skin darkening (Y/N): Skin darkening (acanthosis nigricans) can be associated with insulin resistance.
factor_descriptions.Hair loss(Y/N): Hair thinning may be related to hormonal imbalances.
factor_descriptions.Pimples(Y/N): Persistent acne can be associated with elevated androgen levels.
factor_descriptions.Fast food (Y/N): Dietary habits can influence metabolic health and hormonal balance.
factor_descriptions.Reg.Exercise(Y/N): Regular exercise is associated with improved metabolic and hormonal health.

thresholds.description: P(PCOS) < 0.37 = Low Risk, 0.37 <= P < 0.64 = Moderate Risk, P >= 0.64 = High Risk

cycle_encoding.description: Original Cycle(R/I) column: 2=Regular, 4/5=Irregular. Mapped to binary: 0=Regular, 1=Irregular.

blood_group_encoding.description: Blood group encoded as integer in dataset (11-18). Passed as-is to model.
